# Audit event codes

<!-- Generated by `make gen` from server/internal/domain/audit/codes.go. Do not edit. -->

Schema `paddock.audit.v1`. Codes are stable English identifiers; events are never translated or rewritten.
The portal renders them through the message key `audit.<code>`.

| `action.finalized_unknown` | Metric label of the reaper. The reaper finalizes a stuck action with outcome unknown under the original action code; this code is never emitted as an event. | – | – (never emitted) |
